notes: Clearer wording while you dictate: the pill says "Recording · let go to finish", and the tray says "No microphone" or "No clean-up" when that is the case. Settings > Storage can now change where model files are kept. A new "See how it works" page shows what happens to one dictation, step by step, and pastes nothing. Help explains how to turn on cloud clean-up, and a cloud clean-up waiting for its key now says so.
